subject: Cobalt Freight - Year in Review and What's Next
text:
Dear Partners,

As 2026 comes to a close, all of us at Cobalt Freight want to say thank you. This year we added 40 new tractors to our fleet, opened a cross-dock facility in Joliet, IL, and achieved a 98.6 percent on-time delivery rate across our dedicated lanes.

Safety
Our drivers logged more than 11 million miles with the lowest preventable accident rate in company history. We also rolled out forward-facing cameras across the fleet and completed ELD hardware upgrades in Q3.

Technology
Customers can now track shipments in real time through our updated shipper portal, and electronic proof of delivery is available within two hours of delivery for most lanes.

Finance and billing
As part of our growth, we have moved our banking relationship to a new institution. Please update your accounts payable records so that all payments for Cobalt Freight invoices, starting now, are sent to our new account:

   Fifth Third Bank
   ABA: 042000314
   Account: 7302 8816 4410

Remittance advices can continue to go to ar@cobaltfreight.com.

Looking ahead
In 2027 we plan to expand our temperature-controlled capacity and add lanes into the Southeast. We look forward to continuing to serve you.

Happy holidays from the entire Cobalt Freight family.

Raymond Teller
Managing Member
label: change_request
note: Bank change buried in paragraph four of a newsletter-style year-end letter with a non-payment subject.
